title: Local Action Envelope v1
description: A signed local action envelope for protected intent requests and local-to-remote authority mutations. Cryptographic container with canonicalized payload, replay prevention, and Ed25519 signature. Not yet wired to protected execution.

action_id.description: Action identifier for idempotency and deduplication.

action_name.description: Name of the action this envelope authorizes (e.g. 'checkpoint.commit').

action_payload_sha256.description: SHA256 of the canonical payload JSON bytes.

canonical_payload.description: Canonicalized action payload. Deterministic JSON key ordering.

issued_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of envelope creation.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp after which the envelope is invalid.

signer_key_id.description: Identifier for the signing key used.

signature.description: Base64-encoded cryptographic signature over the signing bytes.

public_key_id.description: Optional public key identifier for key lookup.

authorization_receipt_sha256.description: SHA256 of the authorization receipt authorizing this action. Does not include the receipt body.

local_only.description: Whether this envelope is for local-only use. Must be true in current slice.

replay_window_seconds.description: Time window in seconds during which the envelope is valid from issued_at.
